whatItIs: jsquil is an open-source project in the general-purpose sdks category. It is maintained by mapmeld and primarily looks like a JavaScript codebase. JavaScript interface for writing Quil programs, based on Rigetti Computing's pyQuil package.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches general-purpose sdks workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: JavaScript interface for writing Quil programs, based on Rigetti Computing's pyQuil package. Make a list of instructions to run on a hybrid computer with both qubits and classical registers, and then use the measure instruction to store a qubit value onto a classical register.
whoItsFor: Developers who want a broad entry point for building circuits, experimenting with algorithms, and integrating quantum workflows into larger applications.
whatYouCanBuild: Prototype end-to-end circuit workflows without committing to a niche backend too early.
